title: TrackScorer: Skyrmion Logic-in-Memory Accelerator for Tree-Based Ranking Models
problem: Efficiently implementing Quickscorer (tree-based document ranking) on racetrack memories where shift overhead to access ports limits efficiency. SK-RTM density/leakage advantages are hindered by data movement cost.
motivation: Racetrack memories offer lower leakage and higher density than DRAM/SRAM but inherent shift operations create performance bottleneck for logic workloads.
method: Logic-in-Memory accelerator designed specifically for SK-RTMs exploiting Quickscorer's bitvector representation and interleaved tree traversal via bitwise logical operations. Multiple mapping strategies including quadratic assignment problem (QAP) optimization for data placement.
key_novelty: Mapping tree-based ranking algorithms to logic-in-memory primitives within racetrack memory to minimize read/write/shift operations.
contributions: Efficient Quickscorer mapping to SK-RTM using bitwise logical operations
Significant reduction in read/write operations and shift time during inference

metrics.other: reduced R/W operations, reduced shift time

limitations: Scalability to larger tree models and generalization to other ranking algorithms not discussed.
